text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah… I'm… fine… I have to do my best for the next race…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I want to be in a ton of races… so I can bring happiness to everyone…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's pushing herself way too hard. I should probably adjust her racing schedule.
